title: The Credit Window and the Member's Pharmacy Benefit Plan Year (Specialty Pharmacy Program Training Notes)
content:
**Rule.** Under the Specialty Pharmacy Program, the window within which earlier fills and payments are counted toward a member's credit follows the plan year of the member's **Pharmacy Benefit Plan** enrollment:

- When the member's plan year began six or fewer whole months before today, the credit window is the last 12 months, so credits from the plan year just ended still count.
- When it began more than six whole months before today, the credit window runs from no more whole months before today than the plan year's first day.
- When no plan year is on record, the credit window covers every earlier fill.

The plan year's first day is the plan year start date on the member's Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment. The number of whole months between a date and today is the count of calendar months from that date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than that date's day of the month.

## Questions and answers

**What does "the last 12 months" include?** Fills shipped, and payments dated, fewer than 12 whole months before today.

**What does "from no more whole months before today than the plan year's first day" include?** Fills shipped, and payments dated, whose whole months before today are no more than the plan year's first day's. Assume today is 2026-10-08 and the plan year began 2026-01-01, which is 9 whole months before today:

| Fill or payment dated | Whole months before today | Inside the window? |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-01-05 | 9 | Yes |
| 2025-12-05 | 10 | No |

**Where does six whole months fall?** Assume today is 2026-10-08:

| Plan year start date | Whole months before today | Credit window |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-07-01 | 3 | the last 12 months |
| 2026-03-09 | 6 | the last 12 months |
| 2026-03-08 | 7 | from the plan year's first day |

**And if the Pharmacy Benefit Plan shows no plan year?** Then every earlier fill counts, however old.
